definitions.explanation: The temporary closure or restriction of one or more traffic lanes, typically due to road construction, accidents, or events. A common cause of traffic congestion in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{車線規制|しゃせんきせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Lanes are restricted due to construction.

examples.japanese: {車線規制|しゃせんきせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Traffic congestion occurred due to the lane restriction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{車線規制|しゃせんきせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}して→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There will be lane restrictions on the expressway, so please leave with plenty of time.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧ (traffic lane) + ⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧ (regulation; restriction). Commonly encountered in traffic reports, highway information displays, and navigation apps. Japan's road information services frequently announce lane restrictions, especially on expressways.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車線規制|しゃせんきせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: implement lane restrictions
- {車線規制|しゃせんきせい}⟦{区間|くかん}→区間：18759_kukan⟧: restricted lane section
- {車線規制|しゃせんきせい}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: lane restriction information
- {車線規制|しゃせんきせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}される→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧: lane restriction is lifted

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧: road closure — complete closure of the road, not just lane restriction
- ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧: traffic jam; congestion — the result, not the cause
- ⟦{交通規制|こうつうきせい}→交通規制：22414_koutsuukisei⟧: traffic regulation — broader term covering all types of traffic controls
